Back to: Nail POS Hub

Rules on every screen
• English first; each person switches English / Tiếng Việt in their profile (P5)
• Tip + card fee always shown; salon keeps no tip; card fee on tips never taken from staff
• Saves offline, syncs later (pill top right)
• Compact, calm, Apple-like; soft fade-ins (off with reduced motion)
• Grey sticky under each screen = what every tap does
• Page 2 = front desk frame by frame (with notes)
• Page 3 = phones frame by frame

Open
• Reader: S710 (web app now) vs M2 (needs phone app)
• Not designed yet: split, refunds, sell gift card
• Staff login: 4-digit PIN or phone number? Confirm with Elang

n1.text:
TAPS · Ticket
• Add service → sheet slides up: pick service → pick staff (who's free first) → row added (fade), totals update
• Tap a service row → edit price / staff / remove (manager PIN for price change)
• Discount $ / % → sheet: amount or %, reason chip, manager PIN → line appears in total
• Gift card → scan / type card # → balance shown → apply amount → line + “$ left”
• By staff / By service → regroups rows (fade)
• Client panel: Change client → phone search; Open profile → full history
• Charge $65.00 → Pay screen; Save, charge later → ticket stays open on Today

n2.text:
TAPS · Pay
• Card reader → Reader screen; amount sent to reader at once
• Cash → Cash screen
• QR / pay link → QR on salon device + optional text link
• Split → sheet: first amount + method, rest + method (not designed yet)
• ‹ Ticket → back, nothing charged
• Reader offline → Card tile greyed with “Reader offline · use QR or cash”

n3.text:
TAPS · Card reader (auto-plays in Play)
• Steps tick by themselves: sent → client picks tip → tap card → Stripe confirms
• Client side (mock): tip buttons → Custom → total → tap → Approved
• Declined → row turns red “Card declined — try another card” + Try again / Other method
• Cancel · other method → back to Pay, reader cleared
• No internet → orange box; ticket saved, switch to cash
• Replay → restart the demo

n4.text:
TAPS · Cash (try it in Play)
• Quick amount ($65/$70/$80/$100) → selected, Change recalculates (fade)
• Keypad → types an exact amount instead (build: wire to “Client gave”)
• Less than due → Change shows “Still due $X” in orange, button grey
• Cash tips per staff → number pad per person
• Cash received → cash drawer opens (if connected) → Paid screen
• Works offline: ticket queued, “3 tickets waiting to sync” pill

n5.text:
TAPS · Paid
• Print → receipt printer; failure → “Printer not found” + Retry / Text instead
• Text → sends to client's phone (consent saved) → toast “Receipt texted”
• Email → asks for email if missing
• No receipt → just closes
• Book it → calendar opens on Mon Dec 14 with Kim pre-picked
• New ticket → empty ticket; staff phones get their share (P4)

n6.text:
TAPS · Phone
• P1 QR: Text pay link → sends link; status waits (pulse) → turns to Paid when client pays
• P2 Client: tip button → selected, total updates; Apple Pay / Google Pay → wallet sheet → P3; Pay with card → card form
• P3 Receipt: Book next visit → booking link with Kim pre-picked
• P4 Staff: avatar → Profile; Print my earnings → needs PIN on salon device
• P5 Profile: tap photo → Take / Choose / Remove → move & scale → saved (everyone, own photo); English / Tiếng Việt → this person's screens switch at once; Change PIN → old PIN, new PIN twice; Switch person → PIN pad
